contract: Everything this shard found, proposed, and deliberately did not change. Nothing here is a product change: the branch carries no edit to any compiled profile or state pack, because every release-critical change assigned to this shard was proved to require a path the shard may not touch. The proofs are named per blocker and are reproducible from this base.

step1_auditRereadAtThisBase.result: All four report the committed artifact stale AT THE BASE, before any change of mine.
reconciliation: data/expungement-ai/flow-audit/*.json are the Phase 1 baseline and Phase 2 deliberately left them untouched; its regenerated snapshot lives at data/expungement-ai/phase2/post-implementation/.
flow-manifest, question-inventory and ui-reachability regenerate at this base with every top-level key equal to the Phase 2 post-implementation snapshot. Nothing is unexplained.

branch-coverage differs from that snapshot (jurisdictionsWithAViableBaseline 34 -> 21, edgesThatChangeTheTerminal 1135 -> 885). The cause is in the base commit itself: 93e05e94 reverted data/rcap-ledger/public-witness-fixtures.json to the product base after the snapshot was taken, and build-branch-coverage.mjs seeds each jurisdiction's baseline from that ledger. The snapshot's branch-coverage.json was not re-taken in that commit. Regeneration is deterministic: two consecutive runs produced the identical sha256 a3da04b6f6542ee218323b6d2c5d74b857f8975ff4c5aeb2e3a374e6586518b7.
This is covered by data/expungement-ai/phase2/correction-allowlist.json entry witness-fixtures-predate-the-shared-facts and by the base commit's own message.

step2_reachability.note: The bounded UI-reachability sweep was regenerated at this base. All eight of my jurisdictions reach packet-ready from rendered screens only. Washington reaches packet-ready but not payment, which is its preserved clamp, not a closure. No jurisdiction of mine required further investigation.
step2_reachability.caution: Reaching packet-ready is not the same as being release-ready. Every one of these routes except the four already bound resolves its waiting rule through the provisional prose fallback. None is recommended ACTIVE.

It failed with 'AK:court changed type.' / 'AK:court changed option values/order.' and the same pair for DC, ME, NM, SD, WA and WY. courtAndCountySelectorProposal.whatItIs: The controlled dataset and the exact question JSON for all eight court questions and the Maryland county question. Built, applied to the compiled profiles, verified against the audit's own generators, then reverted when the parity gate refused it. Every option value is quoted from that jurisdiction's own repository content; the citations are per option below.
courtAndCountySelectorProposal.granularity: The dataset is court LEVEL and record-holding AGENCY, not a courthouse directory. The repository holds no courthouse list for these eight, and inventing one would be fabrication of exactly the kind this phase forbids for waiting periods. Where a state's own content does not name a venue, the clearly-labelled fallback carries the participant instead of a guess.
courtAndCountySelectorProposal.provenAsSafe: With this applied to seven profiles (all but MD, which is hash-pinned), all four audit generators regenerated BYTE-IDENTICAL to their pre-change regeneration at this base: no flow row, terminal, question node, branch edge or reachability result moves. verify-rcap-evaluator-all51-provability, verify-public-profile-projection, verify-expungement-dtc-flow-unchanged, verify-expungement-fact-model, verify-jurisdiction-slug-routes and verify-rcap-md-pardon-pathway all passed.

browserCrawl.detail: The eight per-jurisdiction crawls require EXPAI_FLOW_AUDIT_BASE_URL. A local next dev origin was started and the crawler was pointed at it with an explicit chromium binary (/opt/pw-browsers/chromium-1194, because the pinned Playwright expects a headless-shell build this image does not carry). The screening page renders its frame and stays on "Loading your state's questions...": no profile fetch is issued by the client at all, while GET /api/expungement-ai/profiles/wyoming answers 200 in 1.2s from the same container. This is the identical behaviour Phase 2 recorded against the PRODUCT BASE source served the same way, so it is a property of this environment and not of any change. Screenshots captured at the base are in the session scratchpad, not committed.
